storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP BongaCams Downloader makes it easy to record live streams and download recordings from BongaCams.com.

How it works: Go to any model page on BongaCams, and either click the download button on the player or the extension icon in your toolbar. For live streams, select your quality and hit Start — the extension captures the stream in real time until you stop it. For VOD recordings, select quality and download — it saves as a standard MP4 file.

It handles LL-HLS streaming, Mouflon DRM decryption, multi-CDN host probing, and VR stream metadata automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized BONGACAMS subfolder.

Key features:
- Live stream recording with real-time capture
- VOD recording downloads with quality selection
- Mouflon DRM decryption — handles encrypted HLS manifests
- VR stream support with stereoscopic metadata
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Real-time capture progress with elapsed time and segment count
- Right-click context menu for quick capture
- Dark-themed UI with coral pink accents
- 3 free captures to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to BongaCams.com and open a model page
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and Start (live) or Download (VOD) — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited captures.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I record a live stream?
faq.answer: Go to any model page on BongaCams.com while the stream is live. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon. Select your quality and click Start. The extension records in real time. Click Stop when you're done — the recording saves as MP4.

faq.question: How do I download a VOD recording?
faq.answer: Navigate to a model's Videos page on BongaCams and select a recording. Click the extension icon, choose your quality, and hit Download. The recording saves as MP4.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from the HLS master manifest — typically multiple resolutions up to 1080p. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first).

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a BONGACAMS subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial captures after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited captures.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding the stream?
faq.answer: Make sure the model is currently live. If the model is offline or in a private show, the extension will display a status message. Refresh the page if issues persist.

faq.question: Does this support VR streams?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects VR streams and preserves stereoscopic metadata (stereoPacking, frameFormat, horizontalAngle) in the filename.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All stream processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
